title: Who gets which right?
instruction: Now you're the administrator. You're sharing a document for a group project. Who gets which right?

items.text: Classmates in your group who are writing the project with you.
items.why: They write with you, so they need to change the text.

items.text: The whole class, so they can read the projects after they're handed in.
items.why: They'll read it and won't break anything.

items.text: Anyone on the internet who gets the link.
items.why: You share with named people, and only as much as is needed.

items.text: A new group member who will finish the conclusion with you.
items.why: They're writing with you, so they need to change the text.

items.text: A friend who will just read through the text and add spelling notes.
items.why: They'll put the notes in comments; they don't need to change the text.

items.text: Your parents, who want to see what you're working on.
items.why: They just want to look, so viewing is enough.

items.text: A pupil from another class who wants to copy the project.
items.why: Don't help with copying. Don't share.

items.text: An unknown account asking for access to the document.
items.why: You don't know who it is. Don't give access.

debrief: Give everyone only the right they really need. Whoever writes, edits. Whoever advises, comments. Whoever only looks, views. And whoever doesn't belong to the document gets nothing.
